name: alert
title: Alert
description: A note or a problem in a #171717 box on Black: a Lucide icon, the subject in DM Sans Medium, a muted line under it and the button that goes with it. Red for what broke.
use_for: A plan note, a failed payment, a search that needs a change: one box per message, with the action that settles it.
never: A spectrum color fill or a glow
A border or a shadow around the box
Red for anything that did not break
source: Derived from the guidelines: the #171717 card fill on Black with the 10px canvas corner (8px here), DM Sans Medium for labels, the brand's voice ("$10 for your first month, then $20/month"). shadcn's alert for anatomy.
